rationale: The program defines the class 'InputReader' (req_01). It implements __iter__ which delegates to _read_from_file or _read_from_bucket, providing an iterator over contents from a file or S3 bucket (req_02). The __init__ method accepts a 'fail_on_missing' boolean parameter, and the read methods raise exceptions if this flag is True when input is missing (req_03).
